name: JellyGlance health
description: Glance heartbeat and ops digest status.

displayConfig.template:
<Stack gap="sm" p="xs">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center">
    <Group gap="xs">
      <Avatar src="https://jellyglance.com/project-logo.png" size={24} radius="xl" />
      <Stack gap={0}>
        <Text fw={800} size="sm">JellyGlance</Text>
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{data.jellyfinName} {data.jellyfinVersion}</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <Badge variant="light" color={data.jellyglance ? "teal" : "red"}>{data.jellyglance ? "Online" : "Down"}</Badge>
  </Group>
  <Card withBorder radius="md" p="sm">
    <Group justify="space-between">
      <Text size="sm">Ops digest</Text>
      <Badge variant="light" color={data.digestOk ? "teal" : "orange"}>
        {data.digestOk ? "Clear" : String(data.digest) + " items"}
      </Badge>
    </Group>
  </Card>
</Stack>
